name: data-grid
description: A grid with typed cells. The status gives the reason for a wait. If no receipt comes back, the grid offers Retry and Cancel. Cancel keeps the sent edit Changed if it is the last edit of the cell. A newer edit stays ready to send. A successful receipt shows Done. The kit computes no formula.
